jobs.description:
Talencia is looking for a “Data Analyst” for one of its clients.  

Start date : April/May

Location : Bruxelles

Duration : Long

Description :

As a Data Analyst, you transform complex datasets into actionable insights that support the company's marketing strategy and customer engagement initiatives. You act as a bridge between raw data and business decision-making, helping teams better understand customer behavior. Your analyses contribute directly to strategic decisions by providing clear, data-driven recommendations.

 

Profile

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in a quantitative field (Business Engineering, Statistics, Computer Science, Data Science or equivalent).
• Strong proficiency in SQL is required.
• Experience with BigQuery or data visualization tools is considered a strong advantage.
• Good knowledge of the Google ecosystem and tools.
• Strong ability to translate complex analytical results into clear business recommendations.
• Analytical mindset combined with a strong business understanding of customer-driven environments 
• Confident communicator able to present insights and recommendations effectively.
• Fluent in French or Dutch, and English.
If you are interested in or know someone who could be, don't hesitate to contact me :0472 28 62 19

Waiter / Floor Supervisor – Brusketta Antwerp
 

Brusketta is a vibrant Neapolitan restaurant located on Jan van Rijswijcklaan in Antwerp. Known for its lively atmosphere, authentic Italian hospitality and busy services, we are looking for an e
xperienced Waiter / Floor Supervisor who is ready to take responsibility on the floor.
 

We are looking for someone who doesn't just serve tables, but takes ownership of the entire guest experience. Someone who leads by example, stays organized under pressure and knows how to keep a busy restaurant running smoothly.
Extra perk: 
Sundays off – every single week! Enjoy your Sundays with family and friends. No Sunday shifts at Brusketta!

• Welcome guests, take orders accurately and advise on dishes and wines 

• Serve efficiently, even when the restaurant and terrace are full 

• Lead the floor during service: divide tasks, keep the pace and motivate the team 

• Keep communication between floor, bar and kitchen clear 

• Solve problems calmly before guests notice them 

• Make sure service standards and opening/closing routines are followed  

Who you are
 
 

• Experience as a waiter or shift leader in hospitality 

• A strong service mindset with natural leadership qualities 

• Energized by a busy restaurant, organized and hands-on 

• English and Dutch required; Italian or French is a plus  

What we offer
 
 

• A dynamic, energetic working environment. 

• Full-time contract, 38 hours per week 

• Competitive salary of €16–€18 gross per hour, negotiable depending on experience. 

• Holiday pay and year-end bonus in accordance with sector regulations. 

• Commuting and laundry allowances according to applicable conditions. 

• Career development opportunities within a growing restaurant group.  

Ready to take the lead?
 

Are you an experienced hospitality professional who enjoys the energy of a busy restaurant and knows how to bring out the best in a team?
 

We would love to meet you!
 

Join Brusketta and become the driving force behind our service!
 

Send your CV, a photo and a short introduction to 
hr@lvpgroup.be.

For a fast-growing manufacturing company, we are looking for a hands-on ERP Application Manager. 
The group will implement a new ERP package (MS Dynamics F&O) and want to attract someone who will lead this project.
 

In this key role, the application manager will act as the bridge between the needs of their business departments and the ERP solution, ensuring seamless implementation across the organization.
 

This is a job on-site in Tournai with travel to their production site in France from time to time.
 

Functie
 
 

• Understand and analyze the current systems (own build applications) to identify opportunities for improvement. 

• Collaborate with departments (production, logistics, finance, etc.) to gather their needs and ensure they are reflected in the ERP system. 

• Lead the ERP implementation, introducing modules step by step while ensuring strong alignment across internal teams. 

• Direct the software partner and other external consultants. 

• Evaluate and optimize current processes to improve efficiency, standardization, and flexibility. 

• Identify custom needs and differentiate ERP functions from other tools (e.g., WMS, MES, BI). 

• You give support and training to the users. 

• Define user roles and access levels, as well as onboarding procedures for new employees. 
 

• At least 3 years of experience implementing ERP systems (SAP, D365, or equivalent). 

• A solid understanding of software environments (ERP, WMS, CMMS, MES, CRM, HR systems). 

• Experience in the food industry or knowledge of traceability systems (a plus). 

• Project management expertise: Familiarity with principles and methodologies to manage ERP rollout projects. 

• Strong problem-solving skills to handle technical challenges quickly and effectively. 

• Excellent communication skills to interact with stakeholders at all levels. 

• A detail-oriented mindset to ensure system accuracy and data integrity.  
 

• You’re independent, a great team player, and excel in building connections. 

• Dynamic, proactive and curious. 

• Fluency in English. Knowledge of French and Dutch is a plus.
